The role of stem cells

Stem cells play a role in regenerating and replenishing lost cellsIt has.

There are short-lived cells in the body that are constantly replaced to maintain tissues such as skin and blood.

Stem cells also have two major functions.

  • With the ability to differentiate into various tissue cells such as red blood cells, skin, cartilage, and fat, stem cells can transform into various cells such as blood and skin.
  • Has the ability to self-replicate by dividing and multiplying into cells with the same ability

When stem cells are damaged or their number decreases, they divide and replace the damaged or missing cells.

In this way, stem cells play a role in maintaining tissue function and shape.

3 reasons to rejuvenate with stem cell treatment

We have summarized the reasons for rejuvenation into the following three points.

Reasons why stem cell treatment rejuvenates
  • Increase fibroblasts
  • Can prevent diseases
  • Skin problems are solved

Now, let's explain each one in detail.

Increase fibroblasts

With stem cell treatment,Rejuvenation by increasing fibroblastsIt leads to

Fibroblasts are cells located in the dermis of the skin and are greatly involved in beauty.

Fibroblasts produce components such as collagen, elastin, and hyaluronic acid, and are essential cells for maintaining skin's firmness, elasticity, and moisture, but it is said that fibroblasts begin to decline after the age of 20.

Due to aging and damage from ultraviolet rays, fibroblasts deteriorate and their number decreases, resulting in a decline in their functionality.

As a result, collagen, elastin, and hyaluronic acid are less likely to be produced, and the skin loses its elasticity, making wrinkles and sagging more noticeable.

Stem cell therapy not only increases fibroblasts;Effect of strengthening cellsThere is also.

Stem cell treatment increases the number of fibroblasts and activates the cells, resulting in turnover and metabolism, leading to rejuvenation effects.

Can prevent diseases

Stem cell treatment isPreventive treatment is also possible before the disease appearsIt is.

Even if the cells in your body are damaged or old, you may not notice it until symptoms appear.

Receiving stem cell treatment before symptoms appear increases the chance of cell repair and regeneration, leading to prevention.

Preventive treatment can also lead to a rejuvenating effect on the entire body.

Even if many cells become damaged or old, they can be repaired by their ability to self-replicate, but depending on the extent of the damage, they may cease to function.

However, stem cell therapyIt is expected to be effective even when cells are severely damaged or aging.It can be done.

Skin problems are solved

The main skin concerns for which stem cell treatment can be expected to be effective are as follows.

  • skin firmness
  • open pores
  • sagging
  • nasolabial folds
  • Fine wrinkles
  • Kusumi

The cause of skin problems is that collagen, elastin, and hyaluronic acid decrease due to age and damage from UV rays, weakening their functions.

Therefore, stem cell treatment increases fibroblasts and produces ingredients such as collagen and hyaluronic acid, rejuvenating the skin and solving skin problems.

Are cosmetics made from cell culture serum effective?

The following two types of stem cell serum are used in cosmetics:

  • human origin
  • plant-based

Stem cell serum is a serum that uses the supernatant liquid extracted when culturing stem cells.

Human-derived cosmetics contain stem cell culture supernatant obtained by culturing stem cells collected from humans.

Contains many growth factors, regulates skin turnover and promotes metabolism.

By promoting turnover and metabolism,Expected to improve skin firmness, age spots, dullness, etc.Cosmetics.

On the other hand, plant-based cosmetics contain plant stem cell culture fluid, soExpected to have antioxidant and moisturizing effectsYou can.

If you want more rejuvenating effect,Human stem cell cosmetics containing stem cell culture supernatant liquid are recommended.It is.
